visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black varsity jacket over a plaid shirt and a black pleated skirt with black boots, dances energetically in front of a white promotional backdrop featuring the CPBL 2025 logo. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor event space. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of the Kaohsiung Exhibition Center under a clear sky; the woman takes a selfie video. Then, the view cuts to a massive indoor hall filled with over a hundred red round banquet tables. Hundreds of people are seated, creating a dense crowd environment. (3) On a brightly lit stage with neon decorations and a large screen displaying the CPBL logo, several men in suits and athletic shirts stand in a line for a ceremony. Cheerleaders in vibrant orange and pink outfits perform a synchronized dance routine on a secondary mobile stage car decorated with colorful lights. (4) Close-up shots feature event-specific objects: a blue and white Team Taiwan towel, customized water bottles with names on cards like 'Lu Xiaoqing', and a menu designed to look like a baseball lineup scorecard. The woman is seen later biting into a chocolate-covered ice cream bar with an expression of enjoyment. (5) The video concludes with shots of various team merchandise booths, a gold-colored world championship trophy displayed in a glass case, and the woman dancing again with a wooden baseball bat in a different outfit—a black hoodie and the same skirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of the Kaohsiung Exhibition Center, featuring high ceilings, structural beams, and a large open floor plan filled with traditional red round banquet tables. A stage is set up with neon lights and digital screens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female narrator's energetic, high-pitched voice introducing the event over an upbeat, major-key electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat (~128 BPM). A digital 'pop' sound effect marks the transition. (2) As the scene changes to the exhibition hall, background chatter and a low indoor room tone become audible, though the BGM and narration remain dominant. The narrator's speech rate is fast and enthusiastic. (3) During the stage performances, live music from the stage speakers (cheerleading anthem) blends briefly with the BGM. Distant applause and cheering from the crowd are clearly heard. (4) Technical sound effects like 'dings' and 'whooshes' are synchronized with visual text overlays. The sound of someone biting into something crunchy (ice cream bar) is briefly highlighted. (5) The final segment maintains the high-energy music and enthusiastic narration, concluding with a rising melodic phrase as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an event vlog and promotional piece for the CPBL (Chinese Professional Baseball League) 2025 season-opening banquet. It showcases the scale of the event, the various interactive activities, food quality, and merchandise to build excitement for the upcoming baseball season.
